description: This Java test class validates the accessibility of the generated OpenAPI JSON documentation endpoint at /bank-api/v3/api-docs, ensuring it returns a 200 status, correct content type, and includes the 'openapi' JSON field. It uses Spring Boot's testing framework with MockMvc to simulate HTTP requests.

classes.name: OpenApiDocsAccessibilityTest
classes.description: Spring Boot integration test class that verifies the accessibility and correctness of the OpenAPI documentation endpoint without authentication.

methods.name: openApiDocsAreAccessibleWithoutAuthentication
methods.description: Test method that performs a GET request to the API docs endpoint and asserts that the response status is OK, content type is JSON, and contains the 'openapi' field in the JSON payload.
